The future looked brighter than ever in the plains of Oklahoma. But now, that shine has passed to other hopefuls in the West. You can’t win it every year, but with modern roster construction, if OKC falters again, that homegrown core may be on its way out. And the microscope on Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren has never been more intense.
